annotations.title: Average new deposit and consumer loan rates in Polish banks (NBP MIR)

description: Use for the average rate on new deposits in Polish banks by maturity, how much more the best deposits pay than the bank average, and the average rate and APRC of new consumer loans. For offers of single banks, use get_bank_rates. NBP interest rate statistics (MIR) for new household business in PLN: average rate on new term deposits (all maturities and by original maturity) with the value and share of new deposits by maturity, and the average rate and APRC (RRSO) of new consumer loans. With Premia za wybór lokaty finwire (finwire_deposit_choice_premium): how much more the finwire deposit index (5 best 3-month deposits) pays than the average new 1-3 month deposit, in pp and in PLN per year on PLN 10,000 after tax, plus a current estimate. Market averages, not an offer. Informational data, not investment advice.
